zh: 看板多出第二种排列：整齐行列。卡片按保存的顺序逐行铺开，同一排的卡片等高，行列间距一致；期望的跨列数与高度存在看板上，像素坐标每次按当前窗口宽度与根字号现算，窗口变宽变窄都不用重新摆。看板数据格式升到版本 3，旧看板读出来仍是自由位置，新建的看板默认用整齐行列。下方菜单多一枚「排列模式」：一键在两种排法之间切换，第一次切到整齐时把屏幕上的阅读顺序存下来，再切回去还是那份自由位置。整齐模式里拖动是调整顺序，缩放横向改自己的跨列数、纵向把整行抬到同一档；卡片与组卡的增删会同步维护顺序。布局与排列共用一套修订号并发规则，两个窗口同时改时后到的提交收到 409 与当前快照。
en: The board gains a second arrangement: aligned rows. Cards flow row by row in a saved order; cards in the same row share one height and the row/column gaps match. Only the wanted column span and height tier are stored — pixel positions derive from the current window width and root font size, so resizing never asks you to re-arrange. The board format moves to version 3: existing boards stay free-positioned, new boards start aligned. The dock menu gains an arrangement toggle; switching to aligned captures the on-screen reading order once, and switching back restores the saved free positions. In aligned mode dragging reorders cards, horizontal resize changes the card's own span, vertical resize lifts the whole row one tier; adding or removing cards keeps the order intact. Layout and arrangement share one revision-based concurrency rule: a late submission from another window gets a 409 with the current snapshot.
